patterns.note: Asymmetrical grid layouts for project showcases, combining large hero images with smaller supporting images or text blocks to create dynamic visual interest.
Consistent use of a clean, modern sans-serif typeface across all text, with large, bold headings contrasting with smaller, lighter body and metadata text for clear hierarchy.
A stark monochrome palette of black and white/light grey, allowing high-quality architectural photography to provide the primary visual interest and color.
A sticky, transparent header navigation remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, maintaining access to key navigation elements without obscuring content.
Project sections are introduced with large, impactful images and concise titles, followed by a grid of related projects, emphasizing visual storytelling and a portfolio-centric approach.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-bleed hero image that scrolls out of view, revealing the content below without any additional animation.
A persistent header navigation maintains its transparent background and fixed position at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll.
A full-screen overlay menu is triggered by a 'Menu' link, providing a clear, focused navigation experience that temporarily covers the main content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold section headings (~3-4x body) provide strong hierarchy, while body text is small and highly legible, often accompanied by even smaller, lighter metadata.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used exclusively across all elements, contributing to a precise and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a clean, open feel within content grids.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its extremely minimal, almost stark, black-and-white aesthetic that places absolute emphasis on high-quality, full-bleed architectural photography. The full-screen overlay menu, combined with the transparent sticky header, reinforces a sense of understated luxury and focus, making the content the undeniable hero.
